regions.full_page: Mrs. M. Giff - 27 - suffering from eczema for ten years - said to be incurable and at times terrific. A friend insisted on her prom- ising to come to Monastery and enroll in Ser. Mass Ass'n - That was last Saturday ... Sunday was able to take bandage off hand. Improve- ment has been remarkable every day. Enrolled To-day - 50c. . Has Con- vert husband and one boy - former away 5 yrs. out of ten. Now wants to do right again.
